messages.en:
I found something that
suits your house to a T.
Trust me, no one has
better taste than I do!
messages.et:
Leidsin midagi, mis sobib
su majja ideaalselt.
Usu mind, kellelgi pole
paremat maitset kui mul!

messages.en:
Thanks for inviting me.
I think adding this to
your collection will bring
you closer to fame.
messages.et:
Aitäh kutse eest.
Arvan, et selle lisamine
sinu kogusse toob sind
kuulsusele lähemale.

messages.en:
I got this for you. Trust
me, it'll totally sweeten
up your suite...uh...of
stuff!
messages.et:
Sain selle sulle. Usu
mind, see magustab täiesti
sinu sviidi...ee...
kraami!
